_README: THIS FILE IS AN EXAMPLE AND IS NEVER LOADED BY THE TEST.
It shows the format only. Copy it to queries.json and replace everything.
The two example queries below are deliberately weak placeholders -- they are
here to show field names, not to contribute a single scored query.
1. Write every query from the worksheet files (raw court text) only.
Never open output/chunk/ while writing. That is what keeps the test
from grading the system with its own output.
2. Paraphrase. Do not lift distinctive phrases -- run
'python test_retrieval.py --audit-only' to see how much you reused.
3. stage: 'case' asks which document; 'chunk' asks which paragraph.
4. For stage 'chunk' give expect_paragraph (e.g. 'p18'), NOT a chunk_id.
Code resolves which chunk contains that paragraph, so the answer key
survives re-segmentation and you never read generated chunk text.
5. Once you have run a scored test, do not delete queries that failed.
Add to the set instead -- the file is hashed into every report, so
edits after seeing results are visible.

queries.query: EXAMPLE ONLY - REPLACE ME. A natural factual question about what happened in the case and how it was decided.
EXAMPLE ONLY - REPLACE ME. A narrow question answered by one specific paragraph.
